subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for Playground AI pilot
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@playground.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@playground.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding + question about PO requirement

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — team loved the throughput numbers. We want to kick off a 6-week pilot (internal sandbox usage only) to validate latency on our dataset. Our procurement team usually sends a PO for vendor onboarding, but for pilots under $4k they ask for a temporary alternate payment path so they don't slow down integrations.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood accept invoice-only for this pilot (no formal PO) for the first 90 days?
- I attached our completed onboarding form (Playground_onboarding_form.pdf). What additional evidence do you need to make a short-term exception?

If helpful, we can sign a short pilot agreement or add an addendum to our standard SOW.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we planned to start next week.

Best,
Ellie Harper
Senior Partnerships Manager
Playground AI
ellie.harper@playground.ai

Attachments:
- Playground_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf, 312 KB)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@playground.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + question about PO requirement

Hi Ellie — thanks for the onboarding form and quick follow-up.

Short answer: we can often support an invoice-only path for short pilots, but Procurement and Finance need to sign off on a few controls first. To speed this up, could you confirm the estimated spend (approx $) and provide the vendor W-9 / tax ID and proof of insurance? We typically require: 

- Completed vendor intake (you already sent it — thanks)
- W-9 or local tax equivalent
- Basic SOC/ISO statement or attestation (if not available, a short security questionnaire will do)
- Point of contact for billing (email)

If you can get those to us today, I'll propose a temporary "slimline" exception to Procurement: invoice-only for up to $5k over 90 days with these conditions (no auto-renew; Redwood may suspend service on missed invoice).

Priyom — looping you in for commercial confirmation and to propose wording for the exception (we'll need to capture it in the deal record). Naomi — can you indicate the minimal evidence Finance needs for an invoice-only pilot?

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding + question about PO requirement

Ellie / Marcus — quick commercial note from my side.

We can accept an invoice-only path for this pilot under a controlled exception approach I call the "slimline exception":

- Term: 90 days from first invoice
- Spend cap: $5,000 total (single invoice or aggregate)
- Payment terms: Net 30
- Required docs: onboarding form, W-9, billing contact, and basic security checklist (I can send the 6-question version)
- Escalation: If usage looks like it will exceed $5k, Redwood will pause provisioning and pierre@redwood.ai from RevOps will reach out to confirm next steps

If that sounds ok I will: 1) add the slimline exception note to DEAL-7831 in HubSpot, 2) attach the signed_no-po-exception.pdf (placeholder) to the record, and 3) route to Finance for final confirmation.

Ellie — please reply-all with the W-9 and billing contact (cc'd Sam earlier). I'll drop the short security checklist in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

1) Completed onboarding form (received)
2) Vendor W-9 / tax form (received as reply — thank you)
3) Billing contact email and phone (received)
4) Signed slimline exception PDF on file (attached)

Ellie — welcome aboard. We're provisioning a sandbox cluster now and will send the first invoice when usage begins. Please direct billing questions to acct-payments@playground.ai and cc pierre@redwood.ai if anything changes.
